title: My Shopping List
text:
Anna goes to the shop on Saturday. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has milk, bread, eggs and apples. She needs two bottles of milk.

At the shop, Anna finds the milk first. Then she takes a basket and goes to the fruit section. She buys apples, but the bananas are too expensive. At the end, she pays and goes home happily.

questions.text: What does Anna have in her hand?
Which section does Anna go to after she finds the milk?
Why does Anna probably feel happy at the end of the story?
options: She bought the things she needed

questions.text: Why is the shopping list useful for Anna?
options: It helps her remember what to buy
It shows the price of the milk
It tells her the way home
It is a present for her friend

vocabulary.definition: a set of written items that you want to remember
a container used for carrying shopping in a shop
a part of a shop where similar products are sold

paragraph_translations: Anna idzie do sklepu w sobotę. Ma w ręku listę zakupów. Na liście są mleko, chleb, jajka i jabłka. Potrzebuje dwóch butelek mleka.
W sklepie Anna najpierw znajduje mleko. Potem bierze koszyk i idzie do działu z owocami. Kupuje jabłka, ale banany są za drogie. Na końcu płaci i wesoło wraca do domu.
